entities.name: PMID:25084811
observations: 2014 BMC Research Notes case report of a Brazilian Caucasian family with central core disease and RYR1 p.I4898T (c.14693T>C).
The patient also carried one synonymous exon 98 variant, c.14256A>C, plus five common silent polymorphisms in homozygosity and eight polymorphisms in heterozygosity.

Authors concluded the associated silent polymorphisms did not modify the phenotype of the primary pathogenic mutation; the patient's phenotype fell within the range reported for central core disease with the same mutation.

entities.name: RYR1
observations: Encodes the skeletal-muscle ryanodine receptor calcium-release channel; pathogenic p.I4898T is implicated in central core disease.
The case report assessed whether additional synonymous/silent variants modified the p.I4898T phenotype.

entities.name: Central core disease
observations: Congenital myopathy characterized by central core-like areas in muscle fibers and commonly associated with pathogenic RYR1 variants.
In PMID:25084811, the patient's clinical phenotype was within the range observed in other central core disease patients with RYR1 p.I4898T.
